definitions.gloss: role; character; part (in a play, film, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The nature or type of a role played by an actor. Refers not just to the role itself but to its character and qualities.

definitions.gloss: nature of one's position; role one is expected to fill
definitions.explanation: By extension, the duties or behavior expected of someone given their position or status.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧{役柄|やくがら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: I take on a difficult role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{役柄|やくがら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧だった。
examples.english: She was a perfect fit for the role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪役|あくやく}→悪役：12675_akuyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役柄|やくがら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{体重|たいじゅう}→体重：03395_taijuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やした→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
examples.english: He gained weight to play the villain's part.

examples.japanese: ⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{役柄上|やくがらじょう}、⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{言|い}わ→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Given the nature of my role as leader, I have to say tough things too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{司会者|しかいしゃ}→司会者：20470_shikaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役柄|やくがら}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}げた→盛り上げる：07895_moriageru⟧。
examples.english: In his role as host, he livened up the event.

examples.japanese: {役柄上|やくがらじょう}、⟦{個人的|こじんてき}→個人的：04788_kojinteki⟧な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{控|ひか}えさせて→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Given the nature of my position, I will refrain from expressing personal opinions.

notes:
{役柄|やくがら} refers to the nature or character of a role, not just the role itself. It emphasizes what kind of role it is.

COMPOUNDS:
⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ (role) + ⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧ (nature, character, pattern). The suffix ～⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧ adds the sense of inherent nature or quality.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧: the role itself (what part you play)
- {役柄|やくがら}: the nature/character of the role (what kind of part it is)
- ⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧: role, function (broader, used for social/organizational roles)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧{役柄|やくがら}: a difficult role
- ⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧{役柄|やくがら}: a cheerful role
- {役柄|やくがら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧: a perfect fit for the role
- {役柄上|やくがらじょう}: by virtue of one's role/position

USAGE:
{役柄上|やくがらじょう} (sense 2) is a set expression meaning "given the nature of one's position" — used to explain behavior required by a role.
